docker / systemctl / journalctl answers - CAPTURED, not synthetic (one file excepted, named below).

Source:   WSL distro "Ubuntu" (24.04, systemd 255) on the owner's machine, as the unprivileged user (uid 1000,
          in the docker group), Docker Desktop 4.81.0 with Engine 29.6.1, the docker CLI 29.6.1 inside the distro.
Captured: 2026-10-02T15:22:28Z (captured-at.txt) by the live contract itself -
          src_daemon/tests/WslCare.LiveContract run with WSL_CARE_LIVE_CAPTURE=<dir>, built and run from a copy of
          the worktree under /tmp in the distro (removed afterwards). Each file is the stdout of exactly the argv
          the product builds (WslCare.Core.Docker.DockerCommands, WslCare.Core.Systemd.SystemdCommands), first
          answer kept. Read-only commands only.
State:    the Docker of the afternoon AFTER the morning's one-time cleanup (research/2026-10-02_one_time_cleanup.md):
          23 images, 29 containers (16 running), 48 volumes (16 unattached: 3 anonymous, 13 named), 72 build-cache
          entries. The raw outputs of the pre-cleanup Docker (474 volumes, 99 images, 2 190 cache entries) were
          never saved, so NO fixture reproduces the 387 volumes / 59.6 GB rows of that morning; these reproduce
          the afternoon's rows (A4 3 volumes / 641.4 MB, 13 kept named volumes / 16.06 GB, ...).

Files (name = the ToolCommand.Name the product gives the command):
  version.out                  docker version --format {{json .}}
  system-df.out                docker system df --format {{json .}}
  system-df-v.out              docker system df -v --format {{json .}}

  ps-a.out                     docker ps -a --no-trunc --format {{json .}}

                               --filter event=start --format {{json .}}  - EMPTY: Docker's in-memory event buffer
                               held only healthcheck exec_* events (85 each of exec_create/exec_start/exec_die);
                               the morning's container starts had been pushed out of it.

                               a container event line, for the parser.

Redacted after capture by research/diagnostics/docker_fixture_redact.mjs (mechanical; run it on the raw
capture to reproduce these files byte for byte), and nothing else changed:
  - labels: only org.testcontainers*, wsl-care.keep, com.docker.volume.anonymous and Docker Desktop's
    desktop.docker.io/ports* and wsl-distro survive; compose labels (project names, host paths), Aspire's
    usvc-dev labels (which carry environment variables) and bind-source labels are removed;
  - a container's Command -> "REDACTED"; a bind source in ps/df Mounts -> REDACTED-BIND;
  - container names -> container-NN, named volumes -> named-volume-NN (Mountpoint too), networks other than
    bridge/host/none -> network-NN, two locally built image repositories -> local-image-NN; each name mapped
    once and replaced in every file, so the files agree with one another;
  - /home/<user> -> /home/user;
  - event attributes: only the kept labels, execID, exitCode, and the mapped name and image.
  The script then searches every output for each original name and fails on any it finds (0 found).
  Ids (64-hex), sizes, times, states, image ids and public image names are unchanged.
